title: Cohere Launches Rerank 5 to Cut Token Use 41%
summary:
AI retrieval precision for reasoning-heavy search and enterprise content is the primary focus of the latest software release from Cohere. The new Rerank 5 model introduces a tool called Context Focus that allows developers to return only the most relevant passages and accompanying relevance scores from a document, reducing token consumption by up to 41% while maintaining accuracy.

The model is available in Pro and Fast tiers and can be deployed via Amazon SageMaker, Microsoft Foundry, and the Cohere Model Vault. Context Focus is an opt-in feature that functions as a dial, giving users control over the balance between the volume of retrieved context and the quality of the AI's results.

We’re also introducing a brand-new feature: Context Focus.

Your LLM often needs a few sentences, not the whole document. Context Focus lets you return precise passages with accompanying relevance scores, reducing token consumption by up to 41% while maintaining accuracy.

Context Focus is opt-in and works like a dial: you control how much context and quality you want.
